settings.title_help: Optional. Shown above the body. Leave blank for no header.
settings.icon_help: FontAwesome class shown next to the title (e.g. fas fa-bullhorn). Leave blank for no icon.
settings.body_help: Raw HTML, sanitised before display -- script tags, event-handler attributes and javascript: URLs are removed. Iframes are removed too unless you allow their host below.
settings.allowed_iframe_hosts_help: Optional, one host per line. Iframes in the body are kept only if their src is on this list, e.g. www.youtube.com or *.vimeo.com for any subdomain. Leave blank to remove all iframes. Only http and https embeds are ever allowed, and this is enforced in the browser, so treat it as a guard against a mistake rather than a security boundary.
settings.background_help: Optional. The widget's background color. Leave blank to follow your theme.
